Subject: Oraya sandbox integration ready for NetCommerce testing

Dear NetCommerce team,

We have completed the requested sandbox integration steps for Oraya.

The CyberSource Unified Checkout integration has been implemented using the provided guideline and sandbox merchant details. The NetCommerce payment/security seal has also been added to the website.

Our approved sandbox payment path passed successfully. Payment completion is verified server-side by Oraya after CyberSource authorization. Browser return pages are informational only.

Please note that the booking status intentionally remains pending after payment, because Oraya still requires operational/admin confirmation before a booking is fully confirmed.

Production credentials are not being used. This is Preview/sandbox only. Please do not use live card data for this test.
